title: Replace And Remove Characters
statement:
Rewrite the active prefix of a character buffer by deleting one character and expanding another.

Contract
- `chars` is non-null and has enough capacity for the expanded result.
- Only the first `size` entries are input; entries after that are scratch space.
- Remove every `b` from the active prefix, replace every `a` with two `d` characters, and preserve the order of all other characters.
- Write the transformed text back into the beginning of `chars` and return its logical length.

Examples
- `replaceAndRemove(['a','c','d','b','b','c','a',...], 7)` writes `ddcdcdd` and returns `7`.
- `replaceAndRemove(['b','b','c'], 3)` writes `c` and returns `1`.
- `replaceAndRemove(['x','y'], 2)` writes `xy` and returns `2`.
hints: First compact the live prefix by copying every character except `b` toward the front.
Count the kept `a` characters so you know how far the expanded result will reach.
Fill the final answer from right to left so each `a` can become two `d` characters without overwriting unread data. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
inputSyntax: Input: active characters as text, for example: acdbbca
